title: A Conversation With a Police Union Leader

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日新闻简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey there.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好。

sentences.en: Hey, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: Good, good.
sentences.zh: 很好，很好。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Vince Champion.
sentences.zh: 我是文斯·尚普、

sentences.en: Hi, Mr. Champion.
sentences.zh: 嗨，尚普先生。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: Sounds like you've been having pretty long days, so we appreciate you.
sentences.zh: 听起来你最近的日子挺漫长的，所以我们很感激你。

sentences.en: It's been interesting, to say the leaSt.
sentences.zh: 至少可以说，这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: Can you just start by telling me what you do?
sentences.zh: 你能先告诉我你是做什么的吗？

sentences.en: I'm the Southeast Regional Director for the International Brotherhood of Police Officers.
sentences.zh: 我是国际警员兄弟会东南地区主任。

sentences.en: Basically, I'm the Director for the Police Union.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我是警察工会的主任。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And for those who don't know the International Brotherhood of Police Officers, this is a major police union in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不了解国际警员兄弟会的人来说，这是美国的一个主要警察工会。

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生。

sentences.en: We are a national union.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个全国性的工会。

sentences.en: We are all over the U.S., but all around, we are probably, just the officers alone, we're at about 15,000 plus.
sentences.zh: 我们遍布全美，但总的来说，仅警员人数大概就在15,000人以上。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, I want to ask you as a union head about what appears to be a growing consensus that in this discussion and this debate about changing policing,
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为工会负责人，我想问你关于一个似乎日益扩大的共识：在关于改变警务的讨论和辩论中，

sentences.en: that unions have been a barrier.
sentences.zh: 工会一直是阻碍。

sentences.en: That they have created systems, and I know you may disagree with this, but let me just get through it.
sentences.zh: 它们建立了一些系统，我知道你可能不同意这一点，但请让我说完。

sentences.en: The perception is that unions have created systems that protect police officers, at times even the most problematic officers,
sentences.zh: 人们的看法是，工会建立的系统保护了警员，有时甚至保护了问题最严重的警员，

sentences.en: by making it challenging to see complaints against those officers, and by erecting significant barriers to firing them.
sentences.zh: 它们使得查阅针对这些警员的投诉变得困难，并为解雇他们设置了巨大的障碍。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》的我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: In the weeks since George Floyd was killed by former Minneapolis police officer Derek Chauvin, Americans have been confronting hard questions about bias and racism within policing,
sentences.zh: 在乔治·弗洛伊德被前明尼阿波利斯警员德里克·肖万杀害后的几周里，美国人一直在直面关于警务内部偏见和种族主义的艰难问题，

sentences.en: and what the role of the police should be.
sentences.zh: 以及警察的角色应该是什么。

sentences.en: And in the face of those questions is another question,
sentences.zh: 在这些问题面前是另一个问题，

sentences.en: is the culture of policing and the resistance to change by some police unions so entrenched that whatever change is necessary would require fundamental rethinking from the outside,
sentences.zh: 警察的文化以及某些警察工会对改变的抵制是否根深蒂固，以至于任何必要的改变都需要来自外部的根本性重新思考，

sentences.en: rather than incremental change from within police departments and their unions?
sentences.zh: 而不是来自警察部门及其工会内部的渐进式改变？

sentences.en: In that context, we wanted to talk to someone who sits at the heart of these questions.
sentences.zh: 在这种背景下，我们想和一位处于这些问题核心的人谈谈。

sentences.en: Vince Champion is a police union representative in Atlanta, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 文斯·尚普是佐治亚州亚特兰大的警察工会代表。

sentences.en: Georgia is a right-to-work state where police officers aren't required to join the union or pay dues,
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州是一个“自由就业”州，警察不需要加入工会或缴纳会费，

sentences.en: so the unions don't hold the same power to block reforms as they do in many states.
sentences.zh: 因此工会并不像在许多州那样拥有阻止改革的权力。

sentences.en: And Champion has supported some of the reforms that unions have been criticized for resisting in the past, including banning chokeholds, the use of body cams,
sentences.zh: 尚普支持工会过去曾因抵制而受到批评的一些改革，包括禁止使用扼喉动作、使用随身摄像头，

sentences.en: and transparency around police officers' records.
sentences.zh: 以及关于警员工会记录的透明度。

sentences.en: And like many law enforcement officials, Champion has forcefully condemned Officer Chauvin.
sentences.zh: 和许多执法官员一样，尚普强烈谴责了肖万警员。

sentences.en: But when it comes to another high-profile police killing in his own city, the killing of Rayshard Brooks just weeks after Floyd's death, Champion's views are more complicated.
sentences.zh: 但说到在他自己城市发生的另一起备受瞩目的警察杀人案——在弗洛伊德死后仅几周雷沙德·布鲁克斯被杀案，尚普的看法则更为复杂。

sentences.en: It's Monday, June 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月29日，星期一。

sentences.en: Vince, I want to talk about the protests that have been happening all over the country.
sentences.zh: 文斯，我想谈谈全国各地一直在发生的抗议活动。

sentences.en: And I'm curious what you think, as a union leader, when you have seen these vast crowds in 2,000 U.S.
sentences.zh: 作为一名工会领袖，当你看到全美2000个

sentences.en: cities and towns protesting the death of Rayshard Brooks, George Floyd, Breonna Taylor, among many others.
sentences.zh: 城镇中涌现出庞大的人群，抗议雷沙德·布鲁克斯、乔治·弗洛伊德、布里安娜·泰勒等人的死亡时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: What did you see when you watched those?
sentences.zh: 当你看着这些画面时，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: I see people that have a message that they believe that it's systemic racism in the police departments.
sentences.zh: 我看到人们表达着一种信念，他们认为警察部门存在系统性种族主义。

sentences.en: And they believe that because of the color of their skin, they're treated a certain way.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，因为他们的肤色，他们受到了某种对待。

sentences.en: They're afraid because of the color of their skin, their children may go out and not come home.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕因为自己的肤色，他们的孩子出门后可能就回不来了。

sentences.en: I mean, that is what I heard.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是我听到的。

sentences.en: And one of the biggest things that I took out of all the videos that I watched and everything was the word de-escalation, that officers need to learn how to de-escalate.
sentences.zh: 我从我看过的所有视频和一切中获得的最大收获之一，就是“降级”这个词，即警员需要学习如何进行局势降级。

sentences.en: Valid points.
sentences.zh: 有道理的观点。

sentences.en: But I guess to answer your question, I think I heard what the protesters were saying.
sentences.zh: 但我想为了回答你的问题，我认为我听懂了抗议者的诉求。

sentences.en: I don't disagree with the protesters.
sentences.zh: 我并不反对抗议者。

sentences.en: I want everybody to be able to say, you know, and be able to tell their kid, when we're not there to protect you, that man in uniform is, go to him.
sentences.zh: 我希望每个人都能说，你知道的，并且能够告诉他们的孩子：当我们不在你身边保护你时，那个穿制服的人在，去找他。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, that's what we need to get to.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这就是我们需要达到的目标。

sentences.en: That's why I became a cop.
sentences.zh: 这就是我成为警察的原因。

sentences.en: You're talking about the need for change.
sentences.zh: 你谈到了变革的必要性。

sentences.en: And I wonder, just to start, what your views are on what needs to change in policing?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，首先，你对警务工作中需要改变的地方有什么看法？

sentences.en: I mean, what I would love to see is law enforcement go to anybody that's willing to represent the black community and have that conversation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我很乐意看到执法部门去找任何愿意代表黑人社区的人进行对话。

sentences.en: What do you feel we're doing?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我们在做什么？

sentences.en: And then we tell them, here's what we're actually doing.
sentences.zh: 然后我们告诉他们，我们实际在做什么。

sentences.en: Now, how can we bring you, the community, to us and we meet in the middle?
sentences.zh: 现在，我们怎样才能把你，也就是社区，吸引到我们这里来，我们在中间会合？

sentences.en: Is it that we need more social workers to where a police officer isn't acting like a social worker?
sentences.zh: 是我们是否需要更多的社工，这样警察就不会表现得像个社工？

sentences.en: Do we need to get more financing towards where we can make a phone call, we being the police, to say, I need a psychiatrist here.
sentences.zh: 我们需要投入更多资金，以便我们——也就是警察——可以打个电话说，我这里需要一个精神科医生。

sentences.en: And instead of them saying, well, we've got to find somebody that's going to take two or three hours because we don't have the money to put anybody there.
sentences.zh: 而不是让他们说，嗯，我们得找一个需要两三个小时的人，因为我们没有资金把任何人安排在那里。

sentences.en: Or can it be, yeah, we've got a person on call.
sentences.zh: 或者可不可以是，对，我们有一个随时待命的人。

sentences.en: They'll be there in 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 他们将在10分钟内到达。

sentences.en: So now we can stand by and wait for them.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们可以站在一旁等待他们。

sentences.en: And then they can take over that mental health aspect, that child protection thing.
sentences.zh: 然后他们可以接管那个心理健康方面、儿童保护的事情。

sentences.en: And then we, you know, we are asked to do a myriad of things that are socially driven.
sentences.zh: 然后我们，你知道的，被要求做形形色色具有社会驱动的事情。

sentences.en: And what I would rather see, like I was talking about, having the ability to have a social worker on call.
sentences.zh: 我更愿意看到的，就像我刚才说的，是有能力让一个随时待命的社工。

sentences.en: The unfortunate part is it's totally opposite of the defunding of law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这与削减执法部门经费完全相反。

sentences.en: You know, it comes down to the politicians.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这归根结底还是取决于政客。

sentences.en: And I really hate to be that way, but it does.
sentences.zh: 我真的很讨厌这么说，但事实确实如此。

sentences.en: And instead of building, you know, parks that make no sense, putting flowers up and down the roads that probably are going to die and you're going to have to replace or something,
sentences.zh: 与其去建造那些毫无意义的公园，在道路两旁放置可能枯萎且你不得不更换的鲜花之类的东西，

sentences.en: why can't we take that budget money and move it over to there?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不能把这笔预算资金转移到那里呢？

sentences.en: I'll stand next to the community and fight for that every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都会和社区站在一起，为此斗争。

sentences.en: Well, what you're describing is similar in some ways to what protesters and activists and reformers are asking for.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你所描述的在某些方面与抗议者、活动家和改革者所要求的一致。

sentences.en: A social worker at a scene instead of a police officer.
sentences.zh: 现场有社工而不是警察。

sentences.en: A therapist at a scene instead of a police officer.
sentences.zh: 现场有治疗师而不是警察。

sentences.en: I hear you saying that that is at odds with defunding and dismantling police.
sentences.zh: 我听见你说这与削减和解散警察队伍是相悖的。

sentences.en: But help me understand why.
sentences.zh: 但请帮我理解为什么。

sentences.en: If a social worker takes the place of a police officer, if a group of therapists is on call instead of a traditional police officer, then why do you need more money for policing?
sentences.zh: 如果社工取代了警察，如果一组治疗师随时待命而不是传统的警察，那么为什么你还需要更多的警察经费？

sentences.en: Don't you need less money for policing?
sentences.zh: 难道你不需要更少的警察经费吗？

sentences.en: One, you mentioned replace.
sentences.zh: 第一，你提到了取代。

sentences.en: I'm not asking to replace.
sentences.zh: 我不是要求取代。

sentences.en: They have to go hand in hand.
sentences.zh: 它们必须双管齐下。

sentences.en: There has to be more of them or as many of them as there is officers.
sentences.zh: 必须有更多这样的专业人员，或者数量上和警察一样多。

sentences.en: I think to many years, there's going to be some skepticism to the idea that there's not a lot of money spent on policing.
sentences.zh: 我认为多年来，对于“没有在警务上花费大量资金”这种观点，人们会心存怀疑。

sentences.en: And the question becomes, how is that money spent on policing?
sentences.zh: 问题变成了，这笔钱是如何花在警务上的？

sentences.en: For example, let's go back to the therapist or the social worker who might go out and deal with a police call.
sentences.zh: 例如，让我们回到那个可能出警处理警察呼叫的治疗师或社工。

sentences.en: Are you suggesting that a police officer needs to be with that social worker?
sentences.zh: 你是在建议警察需要和那个社工在一起吗？

sentences.en: Is there going to be two people at that scene?
sentences.zh: 现场会有两个人吗？

sentences.en: What if there's one?
sentences.zh: 如果只有一个呢？

sentences.en: And if there's one, do we need that police officer?
sentences.zh: 如果只有一个，我们还需要那个警察吗？

sentences.en: I guess one of the interesting questions of this moment is, are you all called too much?
sentences.zh: 我想这个时刻有趣的问题之一是，你们是不是被叫去的次数太多了？

sentences.en: Is the system built too heavily around the idea that you dial those three digits, 911, and a police officer with a gun shows up?
sentences.zh: 这个系统是否过分建立在“你拨打这三个数字 911，就会出现一个带枪的警察”这种理念上？

sentences.en: Is that not what we need?
sentences.zh: 难道这不是我们需要的吗？

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: It's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: Because thinking back, I mean, there are scenarios where, yeah, we weren't needed.
sentences.zh: 因为回想起来，我的意思是，确实有些情况下，是的，我们并不被需要。

sentences.en: And maybe we shouldn't have got the call.
sentences.zh: 也许我们本不该接到那个电话。

sentences.en: But unfortunately...
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是……

sentences.en: That's the system.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个系统。

sentences.en: They only know 911.
sentences.zh: 他们只知道 911。

sentences.en: Nobody knows the seven-digit number or the 10-digit number to call anyone else.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道可以打七位数的号码或十位数的号码来找其他人。

sentences.en: So I guess if you look at it that way and you're framing it that way, I still don't know if there's enough funding.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果你从这个角度来看，并这样构架它，我仍然不知道资金是否充足。

sentences.en: But if you're talking in relation to if we took calls away, I don't want to say away, but calls that aren't necessary for law enforcement, and we were able to,
sentences.zh: 但如果你所说的相关情况是，如果我们把那些对于执法部门来说不必要的呼叫——我不想说拿掉，但就是那些呼叫拿掉，并且我们能够，

sentences.en: I don't know how we would do it, teach or whatever the word you use, the public to call another number, then maybe, yeah,
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们该怎么做，教导或无论你用什么词，公众去拨打另一个号码，那么也许，是的，

sentences.en: that may be something that would cause the cost factor to go down.
sentences.zh: 那可能会导致成本因素下降。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But if that works out, everybody starts to now call, you know, they see a homeless person talking to themselves instead of calling law enforcement, they call the therapist number,
sentences.zh: 但如果这行得通，现在每个人都开始拨打，你知道的，他们看到一个自言自语的无家可归的人，不再报警，而是拨打治疗师的号码，

sentences.en: that person goes out, everything goes real good.
sentences.zh: 那个人出动了，一切进展顺利。

sentences.en: They get that person someplace to live or figure out how to get them safe.
sentences.zh: 他们给那个人找了个住处，或者想办法确保他们的安全。

sentences.en: And those calls for service go down, and that leaves law enforcement to, you know, handle the real, I guess, emergencies.
sentences.zh: 这些服务呼叫减少了，这就让执法部门能够，你知道的，去处理真正的，我猜，紧急情况。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think if you put that in practice and then you start doing a cost analysis on it, it could actually lower the budgets.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为如果你把这付诸实践，然后开始对其进行成本分析，它实际上可以降低预算。

sentences.en: And I'm not even saying now that the budget shouldn't be looked at and seeing if there's another way to do that because, look, a lot of officers, we're social workers,
sentences.zh: 我甚至不是说现在不应该审视预算，看看有没有别的方法可以做到这一点，因为，看，很多警员，我们就是社工，

sentences.en: we're marriage counselors, we're doctors sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我们是婚姻顾问，有时我们是医生。

sentences.en: We're more than actually what we were trained to be.
sentences.zh: 我们实际发挥的作用超越了我们受到的培训。

sentences.en: I mean, we try to train for everything that we can, but we just can't be.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们尽量为我们能想到的一切接受培训，但我们就是做不到面面俱到。

sentences.en: And then, but you then expect us to, not you, I'm just saying as a society, as a whole, you expect us to.
sentences.zh: 然后，但你却期望我们——不是你，我只是说作为整个社会，你期望我们做到。

sentences.en: And then when we slip up, we're the enemy.
sentences.zh: 然后当我们犯错时，我们就是敌人。

sentences.en: And yeah, I mean, I can see your point.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我能理解你的观点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I think for the people who are calling for reform, what you have just described as a problem is to them a problem as well.
sentences.zh: 我想对于那些呼吁改革的人来说，你刚才描述的问题对他们来说也是一个问题。

sentences.en: Police officers train for one thing, public safety, being asked to respond to all manner of scenarios that are not pure questions of public safety.
sentences.zh: 警察只接受过一方面即公共安全的培训，却被要求应对并非纯粹公共安全问题的各种场景。

sentences.en: And then there being problems in those encounters that have now led people to question why police respond to those in the first place.
sentences.zh: 然后在这些接触中出现了问题，现在导致人们质疑为什么警察一开始要应对这些事情。

sentences.en: Good point.
sentences.zh: 好观点。

sentences.en: I mean, and I can't disagree with that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我对此无法反驳。

sentences.en: Do you ever find yourself as a union leader representing a police officer who has been disciplined and who faces perhaps expulsion, termination?
sentences.zh: 你作为一名工会领袖，有没有发现自己代表了一名受到纪律处分、可能面临被开除或解雇的警察？

sentences.en: And yet because of a contract or because of your own kind of union instincts and ethos, you're supposed to defend them.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于合同或者由于你自己那种工会的直觉和精神，你本该为他们辩护？

sentences.en: I'm thinking about, for example, officers that we have learned about over the past few years with 10, 12, 15,
sentences.zh: 我想到了，例如，我们在过去几年中了解到的那些警员，他们身上有 10、12、15、

sentences.en: 17 complaints of misconduct against them who end up in one of these shootings.
sentences.zh: 17 起针对他们的不当行为投诉，最终卷入了一起枪击事件。

sentences.en: And everyone looks back and says, wow, look at that record.
sentences.zh: 每个人回过头来看都会说，哇，看看那个记录。

sentences.en: And then I always imagine, and maybe I'm misimagining, that there's a union official, maybe he looks like you, and he is defending that officer from being terminated.
sentences.zh: 然后我总是想象——也许我想象得不对——有一个工会官员，也许他长得像你，他正在为那个警员辩护，不让他被解雇。

sentences.en: I think you use a broad brush.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你一概而论了。

sentences.en: When I first took over in Florida, the union, and I first elected as a president, I lost members because I refused to lie for them to try to keep their jobs.
sentences.zh: 当我在佛罗里达州刚接手工会，刚当选为主席时，我失去了会员，因为我拒绝为他们说谎以保住他们的工作。

sentences.en: My job as a union representative is to give you the ability to be treated fairly.
sentences.zh: 我作为工会代表的工作是给你争取被公平对待的能力。

sentences.en: If you did wrong, we need to go forth and go before whomever we have to go for for your due process.
sentences.zh: 如果你做错了，我们需要继续前进，走到我们为了你的正当程序必须去见的人面前。

sentences.en: The one fortunate thing that I have in a right to work state is I'm not bound to represent everybody.
sentences.zh: 我在一个“自由就业”州拥有的唯一幸运之处在于，我不被强制代表每一个人。

sentences.en: I have the right, even though you pay your dues to us, and I have the right to turn you down for representation.
sentences.zh: 我拥有这个权利，即便你们向我们缴纳了会费，我也有权拒绝代表你们。

sentences.en: I mean, the reason I'm asking these questions is because some police unions around the country have resisted efforts to make public complaints against police officers,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我之所以问这些问题，是因为全国一些警察工会一直在抵制公开针对警员投诉的努力，

sentences.en: and they have fiercely resisted eliminating firing police officers who are accused of a pattern of misconduct.
sentences.zh: 而且他们极力抵制开除那些被指控有一系列违纪行为的警察。

sentences.en: Do you feel like unions are invested in the status quo in ways that mean that it is going to be hard, is hard, will always be hard to change policing in this country?
sentences.zh: 你觉得工会是否陷入了既得利益现状，这意味着在这个国家改变警务工作过去很难、现在很难、将来也一直很难？

sentences.en: I think that patterns should be checked.
sentences.zh: 我认为应当对这些违纪模式进行审查。

sentences.en: I don't know why anyone, union or other, and the police would want to have somebody on there that's going to cause this issue.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么任何人——无论是工会还是其他方，以及警察——会希望队里有这样一个会惹出麻烦的人。

sentences.en: I hope not.
sentences.zh: 但愿不会吧。

sentences.en: Again, a bad cop, whether we liked it or not, we get painted with a broad brush.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，一颗老鼠屎坏了一锅粥，不管我们愿不愿意，外界都会对我们一概而论。

sentences.en: So why would we want to continue having those individuals around causing those problems for us?
sentences.zh: 那我们为什么还要让这些人留下来给我们制造麻烦呢？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费体验《时报》一个月，还无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》App，即可免费体验第一个月。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能获取什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，今天就下载《时报》App，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: On June 12th, less than three weeks after George Floyd's killing in Minneapolis, a police officer in Atlanta responded to a 911 call from a Wendy's employee,
sentences.zh: 6月12日，即乔治·弗洛伊德在明尼阿波利斯被杀不到三周后，亚特兰大的一名警察出警处理了一起由温蒂汉堡员工拨打的911报警电话，

sentences.en: who reported that a man had fallen asleep in the drive-thru lane.
sentences.zh: 报警人称有一名男子在免下车车道上睡着了。

sentences.en: That man was 27-year-old Rayshard Brooks.
sentences.zh: 那名男子是27岁的雷沙德·布鲁克斯。

sentences.en: Are you visiting or what's, uh...
sentences.zh: 你是来这里串门还是怎么的……

sentences.en: I'm visiting.
sentences.zh: 我是来扫墓的。

sentences.en: Where are you visiting?
sentences.zh: 你来给谁扫墓？

sentences.en: Uh, my mother's grave site.
sentences.zh: 呃，我母亲的墓地。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
sentences.zh: 哦，听到这个我很遗憾。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How long has she, uh, passed for?
sentences.zh: 她去世大概有多久了？

sentences.en: It's been probably about a year and a half now, but...
sentences.zh: 大概有一年半了吧，不过……

sentences.en: Okay, I'm sorry to hear that.
sentences.zh: 好的，听到这个我很遗憾。

sentences.en: My birthday's just passed.
sentences.zh: 我的生日刚过不久。

sentences.en: As my colleagues have reported, for much of the encounter, Brooks cooperated with police.
sentences.zh: 正如我的同事所报道的那样，在接触的大部分时间里，布鲁克斯都配合了警察。

sentences.en: Will you take a preliminary arrest test for me?
sentences.zh: 你能为我做个初步的逮捕测试吗？

sentences.en: Is this a yes or no?
sentences.zh: 这是要回答是还是不是？

sentences.en: I don't want to refuse anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都不想拒绝。

sentences.en: It's yes or no?
sentences.zh: 是要回答是还是不是？

sentences.en: It's completely up to you?
sentences.zh: 这全由你决定？

sentences.en: Yes, I will.
sentences.zh: 好的，我会的。

sentences.en: Okay, just wait here while I grab it.
sentences.zh: 好的，等我一下，我去拿过来。

sentences.en: But after failing a sobriety test, the two officers on the scene, Garrett Rolfe and Devin Brosnan, tried to handcuff him.
sentences.zh: 但在未能通过酒驾测试后，现场的两名警察加勒特·罗尔夫和德文·布罗斯南试图给他戴上手铐。

sentences.en: Brooks then punched Officer Rolfe, took control of Officer Brosnan's taser, fired it, and ran from the officers.
sentences.zh: 随后布鲁克斯打了罗尔夫警官，夺过了布罗斯南警官的泰瑟枪并开枪，然后从警察身边逃跑。

sentences.en: Officer Rolfe chased after him.
sentences.zh: 罗尔夫警官追了上去。

sentences.en: Brooks turned around, fired a second taser shot over Rolfe's head.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克斯转身，在罗尔夫头上方开了第二枪泰瑟枪。

sentences.en: Rolfe drew his gun and shot Brooks twice in the back, killing him.
sentences.zh: 罗尔夫拔枪朝布鲁克斯背部开了两枪，将其击毙。

sentences.en: Five days later, the Fulton County District Attorney, Paul Howard, held a press conference.
sentences.zh: 五天后，富尔顿县地方检察官保罗·霍华德举行了一场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: So, we have decided to issue warrants in this case today.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们今天决定在本案中签发逮捕令。

sentences.en: Where he announced that Officer Brosnan was being charged with aggravated assault.
sentences.zh: 他在会上宣布，布罗斯南警官被指控犯有严重袭击罪。

sentences.en: We have had something quite remarkable to happen in this case, and it involves the testimony of the other officer, Devin Brosnan.
sentences.zh: 我们在本案中发生了一件非常了不起的事，这涉及另一名警官德文·布罗斯南的证词。

sentences.en: But that he was participating in the investigation, and would be a witness against Officer Rolfe.
sentences.zh: 但他一直在配合调查，并将作为指证罗尔夫警官的证人。

sentences.en: He plans to make a statement regarding the culpability of Officer Rolfe.
sentences.zh: 他计划发表一份关于罗尔夫警官罪责的声明。

sentences.en: Who was being charged with murder, and who, if convicted, would face life in prison or the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 后者被控谋杀，如果罪名成立，将面临终身监禁或死刑。

sentences.en: Rolfe was aware that the taser in Brooks's possession, that it was fired twice.
sentences.zh: 罗尔夫知道布鲁克斯持有的泰瑟枪已经发射了两次。

sentences.en: Howard said that Officer Rolfe's life was never in danger.
sentences.zh: 霍华德表示，罗尔夫警官的生命从未处于危险之中。

sentences.en: And once it's fired twice, it presented no danger to him or to any other persons.
sentences.zh: 一旦发射了两次，它对罗尔夫或任何人都不构成危险。

sentences.en: And Howard revealed new details about the encounter.
sentences.zh: 霍华德还透露了有关此次接触的新细节。

sentences.en: What we discovered is that Officer Rolfe actually kicked Mr. Brooks while he laid on the ground, while he was there fighting for his life.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，当布鲁克斯先生倒在地上、为生命垂死挣扎时，罗尔夫警官实际上踢了他。

sentences.en: We were able to conclude that based on the way that these officers conducted themselves while Mr. Brooks was lying there,
sentences.zh: 根据这些警察在布鲁克斯先生倒地时的行为举止，我们得出结论，

sentences.en: that the demeanor of the officers immediately after the shooting did not reflect any fear or danger of Mr. Brooks, but their actions really reflected other kinds of emotions.
sentences.zh: 枪击发生后警察的态度根本没有体现出对布鲁克斯先生的恐惧或危险感，他们的行为实际上反映了其他情绪。

sentences.en: Both of the officers are represented by the International Brotherhood of Police and by Vince Champion, who quickly criticized the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这两名警官由国际警察兄弟会和文斯·尚皮恩代表，后者迅速对调查提出了批评。

sentences.en: We wanted to understand why Champion, a union official who supports reform, is defending the officers in the Brooks killing.
sentences.zh: 我们想要了解，为什么支持改革的工会官员尚皮恩会为布鲁克斯命案中的警察辩护。

sentences.en: I wonder what it means to have a member of your union, a police officer, charged with murder in the line of duty.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，当你们工会的一名成员、一名警察在执行公务时被指控谋杀，这意味着什么。

sentences.en: Well, and only to correct because of the severity, he's actually in Georgia being charged with felony murder, which means that if he's not put to death,
sentences.zh: 嗯，鉴于案情的严重性，我必须纠正一下，他实际上在佐治亚州被控谋杀罪，这意味着如果他不被处决，

sentences.en: he will spend the rest of his life in prison without a chance for parole.
sentences.zh: 他将在监狱里度过余生，且不得假释。

sentences.en: And to answer your question, it's heavy on my heart and disheartening, not so much of the charge, the fact that the due process and the investigation that led to the charge,
sentences.zh: 回答你的问题，这让我感到心情沉重且令人沮丧，倒不是因为指控本身，而是因为导致这一指控的正当程序和调查，

sentences.en: was not done at all and very done improperly.
sentences.zh: 根本没有做好，而且非常不规范。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: I know you came out right away and you said that firing Officer Rolfe was rushed.
sentences.zh: 我知道你当时马上就站出来说，解雇罗尔夫警官过于仓促。

sentences.en: Do you still feel that way after reading the charges, after watching the news conference from the district attorney, the videos, all the information that has come out?
sentences.zh: 在阅读了起诉书、观看了地方检察官的新闻发布会、视频以及所有披露的信息后，你现在还是这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, and I even feel more so, you know, we've said from day one, we, the union,
sentences.zh: 是的，而且我的感觉更强烈了，你知道的，我们从第一天起就说过，我们工会，

sentences.en: looking at the videos and everything, we're not saying whether it was a good shoot or a bad shoot.
sentences.zh: 看过视频和所有内容后，我们并没有说这是一次合法的开枪还是非法的开枪。

sentences.en: We don't have enough evidence to say that.
sentences.zh: 我们没有足够的证据这样说。

sentences.en: Normally, how the situation goes in officer-involved shootings, the GBI, Georgia Bureau of Investigation, does the investigation.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，在涉及警察开枪的事件中，佐治亚州调查局（GBI）会负责调查。

sentences.en: The officer is either put on administrative leave with or without pay, and then the results are turned to the DA or to the city.
sentences.zh: 涉事警察会被带薪或停薪行政留职，然后调查结果会提交给地方检察官或市政府。

sentences.en: But the district attorney here decided to do his own investigation that he normally doesn't do.
sentences.zh: 但这里的地检决定自己进行通常不会进行的调查。

sentences.en: And then after he did his press conference,
sentences.zh: 在他举行完新闻发布会之后，

sentences.en: we found, I guess to be politically correct, misspoken, misspokens, if you will, or lies that he did.
sentences.zh: 我们发现了他的一些说辞——为了政治正确姑且这么说吧——说错的话、失言，或者可以说是谎言。

sentences.en: And we haven't even been entitled to all of the investigative material.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至还没有权利获取全部的调查材料。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we still believe that it was a rushed investigation and it was politically motivated.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们仍然认为这是一场仓促且出于政治动机的调查。

sentences.en: I just want to make sure I understand what you are referring to.
sentences.zh: 我只是想确保我理解了你所指的内容。

sentences.en: When you say that there are cases where the district attorney may have misspoken, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 当你提到地方检察官在某些情况下可能说错话时，你是什么意思？

sentences.en: In his press conference, the district attorney came out and stated that
sentences.zh: 地检在新闻发布会上公开声称，

sentences.en: Officer Brosnan, the second officer on the scene,
sentences.zh: 现场的第二名警察布罗斯南警官

sentences.en: had turned state witness and he was going to testify against Officer Roth.
sentences.zh: 已经转为控方证人，将出庭指证罗尔夫警官。

sentences.en: That ended up not being true.
sentences.zh: 结果证明这不是真的。

sentences.en: Less than 10 minutes after that statement came out, the attorney for Officer Brosnan said that it never happened.
sentences.zh: 在该声明发表不到10分钟后，布罗斯南警官的律师就表示根本没有这回事。

sentences.en: He was not going to testify against the other officer.
sentences.zh: 他不会出庭指证另一名警官。

sentences.en: He never said he turned state witness.
sentences.zh: 他从未说过自己转为控方证人。

sentences.en: He's never pled guilty of any charges.
sentences.zh: 他从未对任何指控认罪。

sentences.en: And he has cooperated with the DA, meaning answering questions and stuff, but he's never said that he would be state witness.
sentences.zh: 他确实配合了地检，比如回答了问题之类的，但他从未说过自己会成为控方证人。

sentences.en: So, you know, the question then becomes, if you're not telling the truth now or you're having inconsistencies, how can we believe your report?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，问题就在于，如果你现在没有说实话或者前后矛盾，我们怎么能相信你的报告？

sentences.en: Or did you just do a shoddy investigation?
sentences.zh: 还是说你们只是做了一次草率的调查？

sentences.en: If that's the case, you should have allowed what we consider the professionals, which is an unbiased outside agency from Atlanta,
sentences.zh: 如果是这样的话，你们本该把案件交给那些我们认为是专业机构的部门，也就是来自亚特兰大以外的不偏不倚的外部机构，

sentences.en: the GBI, they're the state organization that does this.
sentences.zh: 也就是佐治亚州调查局（GBI），他们才是负责处理这类案件的州级组织。

sentences.en: Okay, so those issues aside, and I understand why you have raised them,
sentences.zh: 好吧，暂且不论这些问题，我也理解你为什么要提出它们，

sentences.en: I wonder what you make of the evidence that has been presented, knowing that it may not be entirely complete.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在明知证据可能并非完全完整的情况下，你对目前出示的证据有何看法？

sentences.en: To summarize what the district attorney has said in his public presentation, he said that Officer Rolfe's life was never in danger, that he shot Rayshard Brooks in the back
sentences.zh: 总结一下地方检察官在公开陈述中所说的话，他称罗尔夫警官的生命从未面临危险，他在雷沙德·布鲁克斯逃跑时向其背部开枪，

sentences.en: when Brooks was running away, and that after Brooks was shot,
sentences.zh: 并且在布鲁克斯中枪倒地后，

sentences.en: Officer Rolfe kicked him as he lay dying.
sentences.zh: 罗尔夫警官还踢了垂死的他。

sentences.en: Do you dispute any of that?
sentences.zh: 你对这些说法有异议吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: As far as, okay, the first one that you talked about, that Officer Rolfe's life was never in danger.
sentences.zh: 就比如你刚才提到的第一点，即罗尔夫警官的生命从未面临危险。

sentences.en: Let's not forget, there was a fight ensued.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，当时发生了一场搏斗。

sentences.en: One officer did go to the hospital with a concussion.
sentences.zh: 确实有一名警察因脑震荡去了医院。

sentences.en: And I guess it depends on whether you subscribe to that a taser is not a deadly weapon.
sentences.zh: 我想这取决于你是否认同一个观点，即泰瑟枪不是致命武器。

sentences.en: But the taser is considered a deadly weapon under Georgia law.
sentences.zh: 但根据佐治亚州法律，泰瑟枪被视为致命武器。

sentences.en: You're referring to the fact that Rayshard Brooks grabbed the officer's taser and shot it twice.
sentences.zh: 你指的是雷沙德·布鲁克斯抢走了警察的泰瑟枪并开枪两次这一事实。

sentences.en: At the officer.
sentences.zh: 朝向警察开枪。

sentences.en: Now, I watched the district attorney's news conference, and what he said was that at the time that Rayshard Brooks was shot twice in the back
sentences.zh: 我看了地方检察官的新闻发布会，他所说的是，在雷沙德·布鲁克斯的背部被罗尔夫警官击中两枪时，

sentences.en: by Officer Rolfe, he had twice shot the taser in such a way that it was essentially empty and unusable, and that this would be something that an officer like Officer Rolfe
sentences.zh: 他已经开枪发射了两次泰瑟枪，这使得该枪基本上已经打空且无法使用，而且像罗尔夫这样的警察，

sentences.en: would know, having carried a taser, used a taser, that it contained two taser shots.
sentences.zh: 因为携带过、使用过泰瑟枪，会知道它里面只包含两发电击弹。

sentences.en: So in that case, does that complicate the point that you're making here?
sentences.zh: 那么在这种情况下，这是否会让你的观点变得复杂呢？

sentences.en: No, because the taser isn't considered unusable after the two shots.
sentences.zh: 并不会，因为打了两枪之后，泰瑟枪并不算无法使用。

sentences.en: The taser also has a method or a way to use it in a drive-stun situation.
sentences.zh: 泰瑟枪还有一种在“接触电击”（drive-stun）情况下使用的方法或方式。

sentences.en: And what that means is you can actually walk up to a person like the old stun guns that arc in between and you used to touch people with them.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你可以直接走向一个人，就像以前那种在中间产生电弧、用来触碰别人的老式电击枪一样。

sentences.en: The taser still has that effect, so it's still an active weapon.
sentences.zh: 泰瑟枪仍然具备这种效果，所以它依然是一把具有威力的武器。

sentences.en: Sure, but Brooks was 18 feet away, I believe, at the time that he was twice shot, and he was moving away from the police.
sentences.zh: 当然，但据我所知，布鲁克斯中了两枪时距离警察有18英尺远，而且他当时正在远离警察。

sentences.en: Well, that's your assumption, that Brooks wouldn't stop and turn around and come back.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是你的假设，假设布鲁克斯不会停下来、转过身再折返回来。

sentences.en: It was evident that he was running, yes, but if he decided to stop and come back, it could have been used.
sentences.zh: 很明显他在逃跑，是的，但如果他决定停下来并折返回来，那把枪是可以用得上的。

sentences.en: But at the moment that Officer Rolfe shot Mr. Brooks, he wasn't in close range, and it wasn't capable of being a stun gun.
sentences.zh: 但在罗尔夫警官向布鲁克斯先生开枪的那一刻，他并不在近距离内，而且那把枪当时也无法当作接触式电击枪使用。

sentences.en: So I just want to be very clear on the question of
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想弄清楚一个问题，即

sentences.en: in what way Officer Rolfe would have believed that his life was in danger in that moment.
sentences.zh: 罗尔夫警官在那个瞬间究竟凭什么认为自己的生命受到了威胁。

sentences.en: You're painting a scenario where something could have changed, someone might have done something,
sentences.zh: 你在描绘这样一种情景：情况可能会发生变化，某人可能会做出某种举动，

sentences.en: Brooks might have turned around, might have come back at him, but at that very moment,
sentences.zh: 布鲁克斯可能会转身，可能会朝他冲回来，但在那个当下，

sentences.en: 18 feet away or so, when the cartridge has been spent and its only role was as a stun gun, how was Officer Rolfe's life in danger?
sentences.zh: 在大约18英尺远的地方，弹药已经打光、其唯一作用只剩接触式电击枪时，罗尔夫警官的生命怎么就受到威胁了？

sentences.en: Well, you're assuming that they didn't fire simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你这是在假设他们不是同时开枪的。

sentences.en: You don't know that, and we don't know that.
sentences.zh: 你不知道，我们也不知道。

sentences.en: You're assuming that he fired the taser and then that Officer Rolfe shot.
sentences.zh: 你假设是他先开了泰瑟枪，然后罗尔夫警官才开枪。

sentences.en: Well, nobody knows that, including the district attorney.
sentences.zh: 好吧，没有人知道这一点，包括地方检察官在内。

sentences.en: You don't know when Officer Rolfe decided to squeeze the trigger.
sentences.zh: 你不知道罗尔夫警官是什么时候决定扣动扳机的。

sentences.en: We don't know when Mr. Brooks decided to squeeze the trigger.
sentences.zh: 我们也不知道布鲁克斯先生是什么时候决定扣动扳机的。

sentences.en: Did they do it at the same time?
sentences.zh: 他们是同时开的枪吗？

sentences.en: Did they not?
sentences.zh: 还是没有？

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不得而知。

sentences.en: We can find that out.
sentences.zh: 我们可以把这点查清楚。

sentences.en: So again, you're making an assumption
sentences.zh: 所以再次说明，你是在做一个假设，

sentences.en: that Brooks fired and then the officer fired.
sentences.zh: 假设布鲁克斯先开枪，然后警察才开枪。

sentences.en: We just don't know that, and I can't make that assumption either.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道这一点，我也不能做出那样的假设。

sentences.en: My recollection from watching the video and the president...
sentences.zh: 我从观看视频和发布会中记忆的印象是……

sentences.en: But you can't do that.
sentences.zh: 但你不能这么做。

sentences.en: I mean, you can't because you don't know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你不能这样做，因为你根本不知道。

sentences.en: You haven't done time distance.
sentences.zh: 你没有做过时间和距离的测算。

sentences.en: You don't know the time that it takes for a person to think, to squeeze the trigger.
sentences.zh: 你不知道一个人思考、扣动扳机需要花费多少时间。

sentences.en: You don't know how much time it took him to draw his weapon.
sentences.zh: 你也不知道他拔出武器花了多少时间。

sentences.en: So I don't know how you can make any assumptions from that video.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道你怎么能根据那个视频得出任何假设。

sentences.en: And if you're asking that, that's what you're asking for, assumptions, not facts.
sentences.zh: 如果你非要问这种问题，那你想要的其实就是假设，而不是事实。

sentences.en: So in your mind, there's not sufficient evidence to discount the possibility that Officer Rolfe felt his life was in danger, despite the distance, despite the state of the taser.
sentences.zh: 所以在你看来，尽管有距离因素，尽管有泰瑟枪的状态，仍然没有充足的证据来排除罗尔夫警官感到生命受到威胁的可能性。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: We're asking for due process and for an investigation.
sentences.zh: 我们要求的是正当程序和一场彻底的调查。

sentences.en: And if the investigation proves what you're saying is right, then that's an issue.
sentences.zh: 如果调查证明你所说的是对的，那这就是个问题。

sentences.en: If it's saying what you're saying is wrong, then it was a good shoot.
sentences.zh: 如果调查证明你所说的是错的，那这就是一次合法的开枪。

sentences.en: But I don't have an opinion there because I don't work on opinions.
sentences.zh: 但我不能在那里发表意见，因为我不以主观意见为依据。

sentences.en: I work on evidence.
sentences.zh: 我是依据证据行事的。

sentences.en: And I haven't seen all the evidence.
sentences.zh: 而且我并没有看到所有的证据。

sentences.en: And I'm not going to answer or get painted in a corner or try to ask a question.
sentences.zh: 我不会去回答、不会被逼入死角，也不会去盲目提问。

sentences.en: What I answered you with is as a taser instructor, what we teach, what they say, what the law says, it doesn't matter, quite honestly, if you read Georgia law,
sentences.zh: 我回答你的话是基于一名电击枪教官的角度，我们所教的内容，他们所说的，法律所规定的，老实说，如果你读过佐治亚州的法律，

sentences.en: it clearly says that the taser is a deadly weapon.
sentences.zh: 上面清楚地写着电击枪就是致命武器。

sentences.en: So, I mean, what's the difference if a gun's a deadly weapon, a taser's a deadly weapon, you point either one of them, then you're justified for using deadly force.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，一把枪是致命武器，一把电击枪也是致命武器，这两者有什么区别？如果你用其中任何一把指着别人，那么你使用致命武力就是正当的。

sentences.en: I want to turn to the visual evidence that prosecutors pointed to in their presentation of Officer Rolfe kicking Brooks's body once he had been shot.
sentences.zh: 我想把话题转向检察官在陈述中指出的视觉证据，即罗尔夫警官在布鲁克斯中枪后踢了他的身体。

sentences.en: And I know that talking about the specifics of this is tricky for you, but you are a longtime officer, you train people, you're a union representative.
sentences.zh: 我知道讨论这些细节对你来说很棘手，但你是一名资深警官，你培训过很多人，你还是工会代表。

sentences.en: That feels like a singular moment in all of this.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些事情中，这感觉像是一个非常特殊的时刻。

sentences.en: And is that appropriate conduct, ever appropriate conduct for an officer?
sentences.zh: 这种行为是否合适，对警察来说任何时候都是合适的行为吗？

sentences.en: Well, first off, to your first part of the question, during the press conference,
sentences.zh: 首先，对于你问题的第一个部分，在记者会上，

sentences.en: Paul Howard never showed a video of Officer Rolfe kicking Mr. Brooks.
sentences.zh: 保罗·霍华德从未播放过罗尔夫警官踢布鲁克斯先生的视频。

sentences.en: He showed a steel shot.
sentences.zh: 他展示的是一张静态截图。

sentences.en: Yes, he showed a picture.
sentences.zh: 是的，他展示了一张照片。

sentences.en: Okay, he showed a picture.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他展示了一张照片。

sentences.en: That's a picture.
sentences.zh: 那是一张照片。

sentences.en: Now we all know a picture's worth a thousand words.
sentences.zh: 现在我们都知道，一张照片胜过千言万语。

sentences.en: We know what it appears from the picture.
sentences.zh: 我们知道照片上呈现的是什么样子。

sentences.en: We don't know what led up to that, where exactly in time that was.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道在那之前发生了什么，也不知道那具体发生在哪个时间点。

sentences.en: But without that being said, you are correct.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，你是对的。

sentences.en: There's no reason to kick a suspect.
sentences.zh: 没有任何理由去踢一名嫌疑人。

sentences.en: And, you know, we don't train to do that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们受到的训练并非如此。

sentences.en: We're not allowed to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们不被允许这样做。

sentences.en: You know, that's normally not the course of business.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这通常不符合业务常规。

sentences.en: So that part of the question, I would agree and answer that.
sentences.zh: 所以对于问题的这部分，我会表示赞同并这样回答。

sentences.en: No, it shouldn't be done.
sentences.zh: 不，这是不应该做的。

sentences.en: However, do I take Paul Howard's word at what that's what that picture meant?
sentences.zh: 然而，我要听信保罗·霍华德关于这张照片含义的说法吗？

sentences.en: No, sir, I do not.
sentences.zh: 不，先生，我不会。

sentences.en: But that's why we have investigations.
sentences.zh: 但这就是为什么我们要进行调查。

sentences.en: And even though it's been numerous times, the media has jumped out and swore that that officer was wrong.
sentences.zh: 尽管很多次媒体都跳出来信誓旦旦地坚称那名警察错了。

sentences.en: But after all the evidence and the videos were looked at properly and in context,
sentences.zh: 但在对所有证据和视频进行了恰当且结合上下文的审查之后，

sentences.en: almost all of those have been turned over or they haven't been found guilty.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有这些指控都被推翻了，或者他们并没有被判定有罪。

sentences.en: But yet the video started out looking bad.
sentences.zh: 然而，视频一开始看起来确实很糟糕。

sentences.en: And, you know, and if we're going to get to a society
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，如果我们即将迎来这样一个社会：

sentences.en: where mayors and district attorneys can look at video and go, well, that looks bad.
sentences.zh: 市长和地区检察官看了一眼视频就可以说，嗯，这看起来很糟。

sentences.en: I don't like it.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢它。

sentences.en: So I'm going to terminate you and charge you with murder.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算解雇你并指控你谋杀。

sentences.en: That's a bad precedent to start.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很不好的开端。

sentences.en: I mean, ultimately,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，归根结底，

sentences.en: I'm asking all these questions because I think a lot of people's reaction to this incident, above all,
sentences.zh: 我问所有这些问题是因为我认为很多人对这起事件的反应，最重要的是，

sentences.en: is why did a man who was found asleep in a Wendy's drive-thru, a man who was not armed when this interaction began, and a man who really just wanted to go home?
sentences.zh: 为什么一个被发现睡在温蒂汉堡免下车餐厅里的人，一个在这次互动开始时并没有武装的人，一个真正只想回家的人？

sentences.en: Why did he end up dead at the end of this encounter and at the hands of police?
sentences.zh: 为什么在这次对峙结束时，他却死在了警察手里？

sentences.en: We did not just get shot because he was in the Wendy's parking lot asleep and he just wanted to go home.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是因为他当时睡在温蒂汉堡的停车场而且只想回家就被开枪击中的。

sentences.en: No, that's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 不，事情不是这样的。

sentences.en: He chose to fight the officers.
sentences.zh: 他选择与警察对抗。

sentences.en: He chose to be a fleeing felon when he hit the officer in the head and gave him a concussion and then the officers reacted at that point.
sentences.zh: 当他击打警察头部导致警察脑震荡时，他选择成为一名在逃重罪犯，随后警察才作出了反应。

sentences.en: So you can have the conversation all day whether you agree or not that the shot was right or wrong and we can wait for the evidence.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以整天讨论你是否同意开枪是对是错，我们可以等待证据。

sentences.en: But what you can't dispute or you should not be saying is that a man was killed because all he wanted to do was go home and he was just sitting in a Wendy's drive-thru
sentences.zh: 但你不能反驳、也不应该说的是，一个人被杀是因为他只想回家，而他当时正坐在温蒂汉堡的免下车餐厅里，

sentences.en: and he fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 并且睡着了。

sentences.en: So I don't, you know, words have meaning.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你知道的，字词是有含义的。

sentences.en: So when you say certain words, you have to understand that you need to say what you mean and to say that our training should keep us from killing a man that just wanted to go home
sentences.zh: 所以当你使用某些词语时，你必须明白你需要言行一致，而说我们的培训本应阻止我们杀死一个只想回家的人，

sentences.en: just isn't genuine.
sentences.zh: 这实在是不真诚的。

sentences.en: I wonder if you believe, as many do, that race was a factor in his death.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否和许多人一样，认为种族是导致他死亡的一个因素。

sentences.en: The prosecutor insinuated this when he spoke of other kinds of emotions.
sentences.zh: 检察官在谈到其他情绪时暗示了这一点。

sentences.en: Do I feel, you know, a lot of people ask those questions and, you know, it's hard to answer because I personally don't ever see race.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，你知道的，很多人问这些问题，你知道的，这很难回答，因为我个人从来不看种族。

sentences.en: I never have.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有过。

sentences.en: I've been in law enforcement for over 30 years.
sentences.zh: 我从事执法工作已经三十多年了。

sentences.en: I don't care
sentences.zh: 我不在乎

sentences.en: what your color, creed, race.
sentences.zh: 你的肤色、信仰、种族。

sentences.en: I don't, it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎，这不重要。

sentences.en: You're a human being.
sentences.zh: 你是一个人类。

sentences.en: I will treat you as that until you, you know, and I will act the same way you act towards me.
sentences.zh: 我会像对待人类一样对待你，直到你，你知道的，我也会以你对待我的方式来对待你。

sentences.en: If we're cordial, we're talking.
sentences.zh: 如果我们很友好，我们在交谈。

sentences.en: We're going to be cordial and talking.
sentences.zh: 我们就会友好地交谈。

sentences.en: If you're going to fight me,
sentences.zh: 如果你要跟我和对干，

sentences.en: I'm going to defend myself.
sentences.zh: 我会为自己辩护。

sentences.en: Do I think these officers decided to shoot Mr. Brooks because that appears basically what you're asking me because of his skin color?
sentences.zh: 你基本上是在问我，我是不是觉得这些警官因为布鲁克斯先生的肤色而决定向他开枪？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: The question being, did race play a factor in this?
sentences.zh: 问题在于，种族在其中起到因素作用了吗？

sentences.en: Not was he killed because they sought out?
sentences.zh: 而不是他是不是因为他们特意寻找目标而被杀的。

sentences.en: I don't, I mean, to answer your question, no, I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得，我的意思是，回答你的问题，不，我不这么认为。

sentences.en: And I don't know how you could, I mean, other than we are in the climate that we're in today, how you draw that.
sentences.zh: 而且我不知道除了我们今天所处的舆论环境之外，你怎么能得出这种结论。

sentences.en: Just to be sure I understand, in your mind, would a white man or a white woman who engaged in the same behavior as Rayshard Brooks, do you think that they would have also
sentences.zh: 为了确保我理解了，在你的心目中，如果是一个白人男性或白人女性做出了与雷夏德·布鲁克斯相同的行为，你认为他们也会

sentences.en: ended up dead?
sentences.zh: 落得个死去的下场吗？

sentences.en: That's the way you want to ask the question?
sentences.zh: 这就是你想问的方式吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Because it's kind of offensive.
sentences.zh: 因为这有点冒犯人。

sentences.en: Why do you think?
sentences.zh: 你为什么这么认为？

sentences.en: Well, let me finish.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我说完。

sentences.en: If you're asking me if a white person, man or woman, would have done exactly what Mr. Brooks did,
sentences.zh: 如果你问我，如果是一个白人，无论男女，做了布鲁克斯先生完全一样的事，

sentences.en: would they have been shot and possibly died from it?
sentences.zh: 他们会被枪击并因此丧命吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If they did exactly what it is, I believe that would have happened the same way.
sentences.zh: 如果他们完全照做了，我相信结果会是一样的。

sentences.en: But the way you framed it is that if it was a white person, would they have been killed?
sentences.zh: 但你提出问题的方式是，如果是个白人，他们会被杀死吗？

sentences.en: You know, you keep saying would they have been killed?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你一直说他们会被杀死吗？

sentences.en: Mr. Brooks was killed because of actions that led up to it.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克斯先生被杀是因为导致这一结果的种种行为。

sentences.en: The officer did not go out again, and I don't know why we have to keep stressing this.
sentences.zh: 警察再次强调，我不知道为什么我们必须不断强调这一点。

sentences.en: He didn't go out to plan to kill Mr. Brooks or anybody that day.
sentences.zh: 那天他出去并不是计划要杀死布鲁克斯先生或任何人。

sentences.en: But the way you made it sound, if that was a white person, let's just go there, if that was a white person that did the exact same thing that Mr. Brooks did,
sentences.zh: 但听你的口气，如果那是一个白人，咱们就假设是这样，如果是一个白人做了布鲁克斯先生完全相同的事情，

sentences.en: absolutely, they would have been shot.
sentences.zh: 绝对会的，他们会被枪击的。

sentences.en: I don't know how to say that any clearer.
sentences.zh: 我不知道怎么把话说得更清楚了。

sentences.en: But let's caveat that by saying with the exact same actions.
sentences.zh: 但我们要加上一个前提，那就是行为必须完全相同。

sentences.en: But they gotta be the exact same actions.
sentences.zh: 但他们必须是完全相同的行为。

sentences.en: We have to be talking about the same situation and just switching the color.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的必须是完全相同的情况，只是换一下肤色。

sentences.en: But I wonder if this connects to something that you said earlier.
sentences.zh: 但我想知道这是否与你之前说过的话有关。

sentences.en: You said that you don't see race.
